# Install packes
```{r}
# Set up renv for package management
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("renv")
} else {
    message("renv is already installed.")
}

# Load the renv package
library(renv)

# Check if renv is already active, activate if not
if (!renv::status()$synchronized) {
    renv::activate()
}

# To restore the environment (for a collaborator)
renv::restore()

# Load the required libraries
library(terra)
library(Spatial.align)
library(rasterVis)
library(ggspatial)
```

# Load the data
```{r}
# Parish boundaries
parish_boundaries = vect("C:/Users/rikib/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/Processed/Adm_boundaries_parishes/Parishes_Kamp_UTM36N.shp")

land_cover <- rast("C:/Users/rikib/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Landcover/terrascope_download_20240305_144418/ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map/ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map.tif")

health_facilities <- vect("C:/Users/rikib/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Facilities/suhsharan_health_facilities_UG/UG_HF_all.shp")

dem <- rast("C:/Users/rikib/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/DEM/Uganda_SRTM30m/Uganda_SRTM30meters.tif")

roads = vect("C:/Users/rikib/OneDrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/vRoads/20240308172748/raw/vRoads_geofabrik_uganda-latest.shp")
```

# Align the data
```{r}
# Align the land cover data to the parish boundaries
land_cover <- align(land_cover, parish_boundaries, show_plot = FALSE)

# Reclassify values directly
reclass_matrix <- matrix(c(
  0, 19, 10,
  20, 29, 20,
  30, 39, 30,
  40, 49, 40,
  50, 59, 50,
  60, 69, 60,
  70, 79, 70,
  80, 89, 80,
  90, 94, 90,
  95, 99, 95,
  100, 999, 100
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

land_cover <- classify(land_cover, reclass_matrix)

# Ensure the land_cover is treated as categorical
land_cover <- as.factor(land_cover)

# Align the health facilities data to the parish boundaries
health_facilities <- align(health_facilities, parish_boundaries, show_plot = FALSE)

# Align the DEM data to the parish boundaries
dem <- align(dem, parish_boundaries, show_plot = FALSE)
contour_lines <- terra::as.contour(dem, levels = seq(minmax(dem)[1], minmax(dem)[2], by = 50))  # Contour interval set to 50

# Align the roads data to the parish boundaries
roads <- align(roads, parish_boundaries, show_plot = FALSE)
```

# Clean the data
```{r}	
health_facilities <- health_facilities %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "_", .))

health_facilities$Facility_t <- factor(
  health_facilities$Facility_t,
  levels = c(
    "Health Centre II",
    "Health Centre III",
    "Health Centre IV",
    "Hospital",
    "Regional Referral Hospital",
    "National Referral Hospital"
  )
)

# Clean the roads
# Define the road types to keep
road_types_to_keep <- c("motorway", "motorway_link",
            "secondary", "secondary_link", "tertiary", 
            "tertiary_link", "trunk", "trunk_link", 
            "primary", "primary_link")

# Filter the SpatVector by the road types
# Replace 'type_column_name' with the actual column name in your dataset
filtered_roads <- roads[roads$highway %in% road_types_to_keep, ]

# Reclassify link roads to their main categories
filtered_roads$highway <- gsub("_link", "", filtered_roads$highway)

filtered_roads$highway <- factor(
  filtered_roads$highway,
  levels = c("trunk", "motorway", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary")
)

# Split the filtered roads into two groups
# Group 1: Trunk and Motorway roads
trunk_motorway_roads <- filtered_roads[filtered_roads$highway %in% c("trunk", "motorway"), ]

# Group 2: Other road types (primary, secondary, tertiary)
other_roads <- filtered_roads[!filtered_roads$highway %in% c("trunk", "motorway"), ]

# Subset roads for black outline (trunk, motorway, primary)
outlined_roads <- trunk_motorway_roads[trunk_motorway_roads$highway %in% c("trunk", "motorway", "primary"), ]
```

# Plot the data
```{r}
# Get unique categories present in the data
present_categories <- levels(land_cover)[[1]]$ID

# Define full set of colors and labels
colors <- c(
  "10" = "#006400",  # Tree cover
  "20" = "#FFBB22",  # Shrubland
  "30" = "#FFFF4C",  # Grassland
  "40" = "#F096FF",  # Cropland
  "50" = "#FA0000",  # Built-up
  "60" = "#B4B4B4",  # Bare / sparse vegetation
  "70" = "#F0F0F0",  # Snow and Ice
  "80" = "#0064C8",  # Permanent water bodies
  "90" = "#009696",  # Herbaceous wetland
  "95" = "#00CF75",  # Mangroves
  "100" = "#FAE6A0"  # Moss and lichen
)

labels <- c(
  "10" = "Tree cover", 
  "20" = "Shrubland", 
  "30" = "Grassland", 
  "40" = "Cropland", 
  "50" = "Built-up", 
  "60" = "Bare / sparse\nvegetation", 
  "70" = "Snow and Ice", 
  "80" = "Permanent water\nbodies", 
  "90" = "Herbaceous wetland", 
  "95" = "Mangroves", 
  "100" = "Moss and lichen"
)

# Filter only the present categories
filtered_colors <- colors[names(colors) %in% present_categories]
filtered_labels <- labels[names(labels) %in% present_categories]

# Facility colors
facility_colors <- c(
  # Blue to Purple for Health Centers
  "Health Centre II" = "#ADD8E6",       # Light Blue
  "Health Centre III" = "#6495ED",     # Medium Blue
  "Health Centre IV" = "#4B0082",      # Indigo

  # Green to Brown for Hospitals
  "Hospital" = "#98FB98",              # Pale Green
  "Regional Referral Hospital" = "#6B8E23",  # Olive Drab
  "National Referral Hospital" = "#8B4513"   # Saddle Brown
)

combined_colors <- c(filtered_colors, facility_colors)

# Define reordered labels
combined_labels <- c(
  filtered_labels,  # Landcover labels
  "Health Centre II",
  "Health Centre III",
  "Health Centre IV",
  "Hospital",
  "Regional Referral Hospital",
  "National Referral Hospital"
)

autoplot(land_cover, alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = combined_colors,  # Updated combined colors
    name = "Landcover and Facility Types",
    labels = combined_labels,
    na.translate = FALSE,
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  # Contour lines
  geom_sf(data = contour_lines, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  # Health facilities
  geom_sf(
    data = health_facilities,
    aes(fill = Facility_t),  # Use combined fill scale
    shape = 23, 
    size = 6
  ) +
  # Add scale bar
  annotation_scale(
    location = "bl", 
    width_hint = 0.3,
    text_cex = 2, # Adjust text size
    pad_y = unit(9, "cm"), # Move scale bar up
    pad_x = unit(0.5, "cm") # Adjust horizontal padding
  ) +
  # Add north arrow
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", 
    which_north = "true",
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering,
    height = unit(4, "cm"),  # Adjust north arrow size
    width = unit(4, "cm")    # Adjust north arrow size
  ) +
  # Add source annotation
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = Inf, y = -Inf, # Place in bottom-right corner
    label = "Source: ESA WorldCover \n& Maina et al., 2019", 
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, # Align text
    size = 5, # Smaller text size
    fontface = "italic", # Italic font
    color = "gray30" # Subtle gray color
  ) +
  # Improve theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.01, 0.13),
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, 'cm'),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.25),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", byrow = FALSE, ncol = 2)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Landcover Map of Kampala with Public Health Facilities")


# Plot the roads
## Define the updated color scheme
road_colors <- c(
  "trunk" = "red4",            # Trunk roads (dark red)
  "motorway" = "red",          # Motorway (red)
  "primary" = "sienna1",       # Primary roads (sienna)
  "secondary" = "orange",      # Secondary roads (orange)
  "tertiary" = "tan"           # Tertiary roads (tam)
)

ggplot() +
  # Parish boundaries
  geom_spatvector(
    data = parish_boundaries,
    fill = "gray95",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7 # Adjust line thickness
  ) +
  # Outlined roads (black outline first)
  geom_spatvector(
    data = outlined_roads,
    color = "black", # Black outline
    linewidth = 3.5 # Slightly thicker than the colored line for visibility
  ) +
  # Other road types (no outline)
  geom_spatvector(
    data = other_roads,
    aes(color = highway),
    linewidth = 1.0, # Thinner lines for other roads
    show.legend = "line"
  ) +
  # Outlined roads (color on top)
  geom_spatvector(
    data = outlined_roads,
    aes(color = highway),
    linewidth = 2.0, # Thinner than the outline
    show.legend = "line"
  ) +
  # Custom scale for road colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = road_colors, # Ensure road_colors is predefined
    name = "Road Types",
    breaks = c("trunk", "motorway", "primary", "secondary", "tertiary") # Define the order
  ) +
  annotation_scale(
    location = "bl", 
    width_hint = 0.3,
    text_cex = 2, # Increase text size
    pad_y = unit(1, "cm"), # Move scalebar up by 1 cm
    pad_x = unit(1, "cm") # Move scalebar right by 1 cm
  ) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", 
    which_north = "true",
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering,
    height = unit(4, "cm"),  # Increase north arrow size
    width = unit(4, "cm")    # Increase north arrow size
  ) +
  # Add source annotation
  annotate(
    "text", 
    x = Inf, y = -Inf, 
    label = "Source: OpenStreetMap", 
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, # Adjust position
    size = 5, fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  # Improve theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.12, 0.15), # Bottom-left corner (normalized coordinates)
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5), # Add a box around the legend
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1) # Add a border around the plot
  ) +
  ggtitle("Roads Map of Kampala with Different Road Types")

```
